landing.title: Generate Your Perfect Cover Letter
landing.subtitle: Upload your CV, paste the job requirements, and let AI craft the perfect cover letter for you.
landing.feature1_desc: Your letter mirrors the key words of the job offer and your real experience, without generic filler.
landing.feature2_desc: Upload different CVs per language and job type.
landing.feature3_desc: Edit the result and export as a professional PDF.
landing.badge: AI cover letters, tailored to each job
landing.how1_desc: PDF, in English, Spanish, French or Dutch. Keep one per language or role.
landing.how2_desc: Company, position and the full description.
landing.how3_desc: Edit anything you like and export a clean PDF with your photo and signature.
landing.pricing_desc: 3 cover letters every month for free. Need more? Pro gives you unlimited letters and no ads.
landing.faq1_a: Yes. The free plan includes 3 cover letters per month, with no card required. The counter resets on the 1st of each month.
landing.faq2_q: What do you do with my CV?
landing.faq2_a: We use it only to write your letters. It is stored privately in your account and you can delete it, or your whole account, at any time. It is not used to train AI models.
landing.faq3_a: You can write letters in English, Spanish, French and Dutch, whatever the language of your CV.
landing.faq4_a: Yes. The letter opens in an editor where you can change any part before downloading it as a PDF.
landing.faq5_a: It is a strong first draft written by AI. Always read it before sending it: you are the one applying.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use
terms.intro_text: By registering and using CoverCraft, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. This platform allows you to generate and manage cover letters using artificial intelligence.
terms.data_text: When using our services, we process your CV data and job descriptions using Artificial Intelligence models (e.g., Google Gemini via n8n) exclusively to generate cover letters. We keep your document history on secure servers (Supabase) but we do not use your confidential information to train our models.
terms.account_text: You are responsible for keeping your password secret. You are free to delete both uploaded CVs and generated letters at any time from your Dashboard. Upon deletion, documents are permanently removed from our servers.
terms.changes_text: We reserve the right to modify these terms in the future. You can always check the most updated version on this page.
